title: Oskar's Scrawled Map
text:
A map on the back of a powder receipt, drawn in a hurry. The Tallow Works, the storerooms, and a wall marked with an X and the words: HOLLOW. KNOCK.

Below, in the same hand: The Order sealed the old powder stores when the Master Gunner went strange. Everything I ever sold came from down there. If you find the way, I'll make it worth your while.

And smaller: Don't tell the Gunner I sent you.
